messages:
sasha: Heads up — sudden spike in eu-central (eu-central-1) at 15:03 UTC. Lots of 5xx/429 on generation API. Autoscaler isn't provisioning new nodes.
jonah: Seeing same. Pod pending count climbing, kube events show "Insufficient resources".
pei: Provider status page shows a BGP route flap around 15:02-15:04 UTC. Might have caused health-check oscillation and blocked creates.
infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-487 — eu-central degraded capacity. Assigned: ops-oncall.
ops-oncall: I'm on it. Checking node pool + LB distribution now.
lina: quick curl from eu-central edge returns 502 then 429. log:
```bash
> curl -i https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-retry-after: 10
```
jonah: `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep Pending`
```text
inference-worker-ck9 0/1 Pending 0 2m (insufficient memory)
```
sasha: Autoscaler loop firing but provider rejects instance creates with 409/quota. Snippet from provisioner logs:
```json
{"error":"quota limit reached","code":409}
```
pei: Provider console shows instance create calls failing in eu-central-c due to route instability; they rate-limited our creations during the flap.
ops-oncall: Proposal: shift traffic to eu-west immediately. Gradual 10% -> 100% over 2m to avoid downstream cache thundering. Agree?
lina: Pushing traffic-router change: `traffic-router update --from euc1 --to euw1 --percent 10`
jonah: Also disabling autoscaler scale-down to keep healthy nodes stable.
ops-oncall: Scale-down disabled. Starting traffic shift.
infra-bot: Deployment event: traffic-router changed 10% euc1->euw1
sasha: Metrics improving on latency/5xx within next 3m. Monitoring dashboards show reduced errors.
pei: Provider ticket opened; they estimate ~45m to full recovery, but says route flap resolved intermittently.
ops-oncall: If provider not fixed in 10m we'll route 100% to eu-west and enable spot fallback in us-west as emergency capacity.
lina: Enabled spot fallback pool for inference-large. Watching for model warmup/regression.
jonah: Observed cache cold-starts on eu-west — first-token latency spikes ~700ms, then stabilizes.
sasha: Capturing mitigation steps into incident doc + adding eng-sre for postmortem.
eng-sre: Copy. We'll audit autoscaler handling for provider 4xx/5xx and add metrics for provisioner failure reasons.
ops-oncall: Current state: traffic at 100% eu-west, autoscaler still getting 409s in eu-central. Provider reports route fully resolved after ~37m; creates now succeed. We'll DR to bring capacity back slowly.
sasha: Follow-ups: add quota-aware retry/backoff in provisioner, runbook step to shift traffic on 409 quota errors, and a test for autoscaler behavior under transient provider errors.
infra-bot: Incident INC-2026-487 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring.
